verdict: State message processor has a large backlog in `inboxes\auth\statesys.box\incoming`. Compliance reporting and deployment status lag behind reality until the backlog drains.
fix: Identify the flooding source. Typical causes: a massive deployment (1000+ updates to thousands of clients) generates per-update per-client state messages; a reporting loop from a misconfigured compliance policy; or a malformed configuration baseline retriggering. For acute relief, set `HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\SMS\Components\SMS_StateSystem BatchSize` higher (default 500, try 2500) and `MaximumDeleteLoops` higher. For long-term fix, reduce deployment fan-out or split the baseline.
